post_title: Modules bound to ACF custom fields
note: Divi 5 dynamic content bound to ACF fields through the Custom Field source. The binding form ($variable with type content, name post_meta_key, settings.select_meta_key custom_meta_<field>, before/after) is the one in a real Theme Builder export the owner made in the builder (a Text module in 5.2.1/5.3.3 builds, field names there are the client's own and are replaced here with placeholders). The Image src and Button linkUrl slots and the Blurb title are not builder-captured: they carry the same binding string and were proven by a live render on Divi 5.14 with ACF 6.8.10 (docs/acf-dynamic-content-evidence-5.14.md). The section, row and column around them are a minimal wrapper.
